intro.text: Seld is a Rosharan work of at least fourteen volumes, not written in Alethi, that touches on the Voidbringers. A passage from it is quoted in an epigraph.

description.text: Its author is unknown. Gashash-son-Navammis, thought a reliable translator, is one of those who rendered it into Alethi, though the note beside the quoted passage doubts that translation and considers redoing it.
